notes.title: [Update Notice Including Bug Fixes ver1.0.2]
notes.content:
[p]Thank you very much for playing Forbidden Ground - Lair of Aooni.[/p][p]We are pleased to announce the release of version 1.0.2, which includes several bug fixes.
[/p][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][p]・Fixed minor issues during the charging tutorial[/p][p]・Fixed missing cursor display in some choices[/p][p]・Fixed flashlight direction control issues[/p][p]・Fixed bug allowing item selection from previous scene after scene transition[/p][p]・Fixed button guide display issues[/p][p]・Fixed progression-stopping bug occurring at specific timing[/p][p]・Fixed resume position bug when continuing gameplay[/p][p]・Fixed issues with dialogue and guide display[/p][p]・Fixed display issues while hiding[/p][p]・Fixed ending branching bug under specific conditions
[/p][p][b]\[Adjustments][/b][/p][p]・Applied "?" display to the distribution board[/p][p]・Changed initial cursor display position[/p][p]・Adjusted action icon display position[/p][p]・Adjusted Aooni behavior and placement[/p][p]・Enabled character control immediately after scene transition[/p][p]・Adjusted voice volume[/p][p]・Ensured proper playback of sound effects
[/p][p][b]\[Text Improvements][/b][/p][p]・Improved text quality in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese
[/p][p]We will continue striving to provide a comfortable gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni – Launches on Friday, August 29!
notes.content: [h3]We are pleased to announce that [i]Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni[/i] will be officially released on [b]Friday, August 29, 2025[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]The 1st trailer has also been unveiled—please be sure to check it out![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://kinsokuchi.com/index_en.html"]Official Website[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ae7xOuwSnSs;full"][/previewyoutube]
